release.functional_area: System Time Tracking Time Tracking Calculations
release.title: Workday Time Kiosk Android Support
release.description: We now deliver the Workday Time Kiosk app that Time Tracking customers can enable workers to check in and out on an Android kiosk. Note: This update is only available on Android tablets and doesn't extend to Android mobile phones. This provides a unified and intuitive time tracking experience for organizations that primarily use Android and ensures a consistent user experience.
release.changes: With this update: • Android kiosks can record time. • Users enter their IDs to check-in and check-out. • Time clock events are sent to Workday.
